title: Kalman Filter
text: Estimate states of discrete-time or continuous-time linear system, 15 inputs, 4 outputs, {G} sets the G matrix; {Time domain} sets the whether to estimate continuous-time or discrete-time states, {Use the current measurement y[n] to improve xhat[n]} sets the update output state estimates using the measure, {Sample Time} sets the block sample time, {Model source} sets how the A, B, C, D matrices are provided to the block LTI State-Space, {A} sets the state Matrix, {B} sets the input Matrix, {C} sets the output Matrix, {D} sets the feedthrough Matrix, {Number of states}, {Number of inputs} sets the number of known inputs, {Number of outputs} sets the number of measured output, {Source} sets how to enter the initial state estimates and initial state estimation error covariance, {Initial states x[0]} sets the initial state estimate, {State estimation error covariance P[0]} sets the initial state estimation error, {Use the Kalman Gain K from the model variable} sets the whether to use pre-identified Kalman Gain contained in state-space plant, {Use G and H matrices (default G=I and H=0)} sets the whether to use non-default values for G and H, {Time-invariant G} sets the G matrix is time invariant, {H}, {Time-invariant H} sets the H matrix is time invariant, {Number of process noise inputs} sets the process noise inputs, {Q} sets the process noise covariance, {Time-invariant Q} sets the if Q matrix is time invariant, {R} sets the measurement noise covariance, {Time-invariant R} sets the if R matrix is time invariant, {N} sets the process and measurement noise cross-covariance, {Time-invariant N} sets the if N matrix is time invariant, {Add input port u} sets the if model contains known inputs, {Add input port Enable to control measurement updates} controls the measurement updates, {External Reset} sets the option to reset estimated states and parameter covariance matrix using specified initial, {Output estimated model output y} sets the include estimated model outputs, {Output state estimation error covariance Z} adds Z output port to the block and {Output state estimation error covariance P} adds P output port to the block. Values come from the instance.
